ValidationRule.description: Prevent edit of an expense after it is approved by HR.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh HR", NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending HR Approval")), OR( ISCHANGED(Subject__c), ISCHANGED(Travel_Start_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Travel_End_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Purpose__c), ISCHANGED(Submitted_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit an expense unless its pending your approval.
